summary.tldr: Authorizes $20.7 billion in federal spending for public service expenses in 2023-24.
what_it_does: Authorizes $20,678,755,329 to be paid from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
Covers public service expenses for the financial year ending 31 March 2024 that were not otherwise provided for.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 7 December 2023 and received Royal Assent on 15 December 2023.
